credits.title: Daffy Season
credits.overview: Daffy is ready for Duck Season, but Elmer is too immersed in his new obsession – soccer – to come hunting. Slowly the world around Daffy turns into a zombie-esque nightmare as the Tunes become obsessed with the sport.

credits.title: Mackenzie
credits.overview: Eleven-year-old Juniper runs away from home and sets out across the Utah desert, determined to reach California and marry her television crush, Mackenzie Astin. Along the way, her unlikely journey becomes a search for connection, independence, and a place to belong.

credits.title: Rumble
credits.overview: In a world where monster wrestling is a global sport and monsters are superstar athletes, teenage Winnie seeks to follow in her father’s footsteps by coaching a loveable underdog monster into a champion.
